# @ratmath/chaos

> Dynamical systems and chaos for RatMath: orbits, periodic points, bifurcations, Lyapunov exponents, fractals, maps of the plane and flows, exact or certified. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as chaos from "@ratmath/chaos"`.

Built from 0.3.0, commit b3c55e6 plus uncommitted changes. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/chaos/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/chaos/blob/b3c55e6/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/chaos/. Full types: index.d.ts.

Types: `type Exact = Rational | bigint | number | string`; `type Stability = "attracting" | "repelling" | "neutral" | "superattracting" | "undecided"`; `type Point = [Rational, Rational]`; `type Range = [Exact, Exact]`; `type PlaneStability = "attracting" | "repelling" | "saddle" | "elliptic" | "undecided"`; `type PlanePoint = [Exact | RationalInterval, Exact | RationalInterval]`; `type PlaneRegion = Record<string, [Exact, Exact]>`; `type FlowValue = Exact | RationalInterval | [Exact, Exact]`; `type FlowPoint = FlowValue[] | Record<string, FlowValue>`; `type SectionPoint = Record<string, FlowValue | number> | Array<FlowValue | number>`

## Docs

- https://ratmath.com/chaos/llms-full.txt: every page below as Markdown, each with a runnable example
- Pages: index (Overview), reference (Reference), explore (Explore), orbits (Orbits, true and floating), periodic-points (Periodic points and stability), lyapunov (Lyapunov exponents and sensitivity), bifurcations (Period doubling and windows), symbolic-dynamics (Symbolic dynamics), plane-maps (Maps of the plane), cat-map-and-horseshoe (The cat map and the horseshoe), flows (Flows, enclosed), periodic-orbits (Sections and periodic orbits), equilibria (Equilibria and their bifurcations), iterated-function-systems (Iterated function systems), cantor-sets (Cantor sets and dimension), l-systems (L-systems), cellular-automata (Cellular automata), mandelbrot-and-julia (Mandelbrot and Julia sets), newton-basins (Newton basins)

## Example

```js
import { logistic, henon, vanDerPol } from "@ratmath/chaos";
const f = logistic(4);
console.log("true orbit of 1/3:", f.orbit("1/3", 4).join(", "));
const c = f.compare("1/10", 70);
for (const n of [10, 30, 50, 52, 60, 70]) console.log(`step ${n}: float ${c.rows[n].float.toFixed(12)}  true ${c.rows[n].exact.low.toDecimal(12)}  correct digits ${c.rows[n].digits.toFixed(1)}`);
console.log("the double has no correct digit from step", c.parted);
console.log("period 2:", f.periodicPoints(2).map((p) => p.text).join(" and "));
const vdp = vanDerPol(1).periodicOrbit({ variable: "y", value: 0, direction: -1 }, { x: 2 });
console.log("Van der Pol's limit cycle, proven:", vdp.stability, "period", vdp.period.low.toDecimal(9));
henon().periodicPoints(2, { x: [-2, 2], y: [-2, 2] }).map((p) => `(${p.point[0].low.toDecimal(8)}, ${p.point[1].low.toDecimal(8)}) ${p.stability}`)
```
